summary: The individual expresses opposition to changes in the E-Rate program, emphasizing the importance of maintaining access to educational resources for students.

claims.argument: Limiting or sunsetting E-Rate will jeopardize valuable learning opportunities for students.
claims.evidence_quote: For 18 years, I volunteered at an elementary school in Boone County Missouri, working with students who were struggling academically. The student and I often used Internet educational resources that were available because of the Federal E-Rate program. I am concerned that the Administration has planned significant changes in the program that will seriously jeopardize these valuable learning opportunities.
